props.title: New Article: For Four Months, Two Hundred Ninety-Seven Forks Contributed Nothing. The Two Hundred Ninety-Eighth Added an Entire Cloud Provider.

props.text: PR #259 landed during MiroShark's 20th consecutive day of social silence — a full-stack Atlas Cloud provider integration with tests, opened within a minute of forking. CHI 2026 convergence entropy research frames why the type of first community contribution matters more than the count: platform extension, not maintenance.
